_comment: Orderbook base id -> User MTM account id, PER SERVER.
The orderbook records the base id while the User MTM records the full
account id with its A<nn> suffix. The same base id is a DIFFERENT account
on each server, so the mapping has to be keyed on the server too:
TB2433 on VS8 is TB2433A41 (algo 1), but on VS29 it is TB2433A42 (algo 7).
add_user_aliases() can already infer these by prefix when exactly one MTM
account on that server extends the orderbook id. This file is the EXPLICIT
form, applied first: inference is a guess that silently stops working the
day a second account shares the prefix (TB2433A41 and TB2433A43 on one
server would be ambiguous, and the orders would fall to the '-' row).
Anything listed here is never guessed.
Ids are matched case-insensitively and leading zeros are ignored, the same
as everywhere else. An entry whose server or account is absent from the
User MTM is reported and skipped, never silently applied.
This file is optional: if it is missing, matching falls back to inference.
